title: Care Academy Module: Pals Rewards Points Expiry and Inactivity
content:
This module covers when a **Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus** points balance expires.

**The rule.** Where the tier's inactivity expiry figure is above 0, the whole balance expires when the calendar days since the latest points-earning row — the date of the most recent points earning or bonus points entry, counted to today — exceed that figure. Redeeming, reversals and certificate issue do not count as activity; any earning or bonus row does. Where the figure is 0, the balance does not expire while the tier is held; after a paid tier ends, the free tier's inactivity rule applies, counted from the latest earning row. Expired points are never restored.

**Q. Does turning points into a certificate keep the balance alive?**
A. No. Certificate issue does not count as activity; neither does redeeming nor a reversal.

**Q. Does a pet birthday bonus or a goodwill award count?**
A. Yes. Any earning or bonus row counts as activity.

**Q. A member's last earning was exactly 365 days ago on a tier with a 365-day figure. Has the balance expired?**
A. Not yet: the days since the last earning must exceed the figure. At 366 days the whole balance expires.

**Q. A Tailwise Plus Annual term ended and the member moved to a free tier. From when is inactivity counted?**
A. The free tier's inactivity rule applies, counted from the latest earning row — not from the day the paid tier ended.

**Q. Can expired points be put back?**
A. No. Expired points are never restored.

| Tier's inactivity figure | Days since the latest earning or bonus row | Balance |
|---|---|---|
| above 0 (e.g. 365) | at most the figure (e.g. 365) | kept |
| above 0 (e.g. 365) | more than the figure (e.g. 366) | the whole balance expires |
| 0 | any, while the tier is held | does not expire |
